ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The tower crane in Figure A is indispensable construction equipment on a modern construction site. Figure B is a simplified motion graph of the process in which 150kg of building materials are lifted vertically upward by the crane. Take g as 10$\mathrm{m/s^{2}}$. Which of the following judgments is correct? ( )

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the graph: On the left side of the figure is a schematic diagram of a tower crane, and on the right side Figure B is the v-t graph of the motion of the building materials, with the vertical axis labeled v/(m/s) and the horizontal axis labeled t/s. The graph line shows: from 0~10 s, the speed increases from 0 to 1 m/s; from 10~30 s, the speed remains 1 m/s; from 30~36 s, the speed decreases from 1 m/s to 0; from 36~46 s, the graph line is below the time axis, and the speed decreases from 0 to about -1.2 m/s. Then reason: The signed area enclosed by the v-t graph and the time axis represents displacement. From 0~10 s it is a triangle, and the displacement is (1/2)×10×1=5 m; from 10~30 s it is a rectangle, and the displacement is 20×1=20 m; from 30~36 s it is a triangle, and the displacement is (1/2)×6×1=3 m; from 36~46 s it is below the time axis, a descending triangle, and the displacement is -(1/2)×10×1.2=-6 m. The total signed displacement is 5+20+3-6=22 m. Therefore, at the end of 46 s, the distance of the building materials from the ground is 22 m.
